prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Save Your Pets", "Connecting your account ensures your desktop companions are safely saved to the cloud."]
1: ["Pick Your Companion Journey", "Choose between instant adoption of starter pets or creating a unique pet from your photos."]
2: ["Select Base Companion", "Pick your favorite species, then choose their unique personality traits."]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion", "Your pet is being initialized. This typically takes 1 to 2 minutes."]
4: ["Signing in secures your pets in the cloud so you never lose them when switching devices."]
5: ["Feel free to minimize the app. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Welcome your new pet! Your certificate includes an exclusive starter accessory.", "Free Starter Gift Included"]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "Right-click your pet anywhere on the desktop to open options, hide them, or interact."]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Choose how you want to meet your new desktop companion.", "Don't worry, you can create more pets or switch paths anytime later in settings."]
9: ["Upload Pet Photos", "Provide 1-3 clear, well-lit photos of your pet for optimal custom generation.", "Front-facing photos with uncluttered backgrounds produce the best results."]
